commits.body: Setup for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md continues in llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief-setup.md. All 98 Gradle worktrees of the 49 Gradle cases resolved online (every configuration of each case's projects) and their offline task graphs configure. All 107 cached snapshot jars are the newest builds repo.spring.io serves, the same for both pins of each case. S30's Spring Kafka 4.2.0-SNAPSHOT no longer resolves (its only remaining build needs a kafka-clients artifact that does not exist for the pins' Kafka 4.3.1), so an init script substitutes Spring Kafka 4.2.0-M2, the first release with the API the PR maps. One job per Gradle case builds both pins, runs the landed tests at the fix and the parent's versions at the parent, runs the fix's tests on a copy of the parent (expected to fail or not compile), and keeps jars, digests and classpaths. Each job has a Gradle home of its own over the shared cache, read-only, so that jobs side by side do not stall on its locks. The record also has the full released-artifact verification (277 jars, sha1 and signatures) and the Docker images. Two redaction findings in this session's log that are test names are proposed for the allow list.

commits.summary: Rerun 41 setup build jobs of the Spring Boot S01-S50 brief after a second resolution pass (verification pending)
commits.body:
The first run of the 49 setup jobs completed 8 cases. S35, S37, S39, S40, S44, S48 and S50 pass at the fix and the parent, and the fix's tests fail on the parent. S46's fix tests also pass on the parent: that is a result, not a fault. The other 41 failed for setup reasons. 38 failed offline because the first resolution pass covered only the case's own projects, not the projects they depend on (test-support's compile classpath above all); a dry-run cannot show that. S10, S47 and S49 failed because the classpath check rejected Gradle's generated gradle-api and gradle-test-kit jars, which live in each job's own Gradle home.

Fixes, all in the cache folder (no upstream or repository code changed): resolve-closure.init.gradle resolves every configuration of the project-dependency closure, which keeps cached snapshots. The pass ran online for all 98 worktrees, with four DNS-failure reruns, and then --offline for all 98 with no misses. case_job.sh copies the generated jars into the artifacts, and its per-class summary no longer reports no-result for classes without nested classes. All 222 cached snapshot jars are still the newest builds; none of the first pass's 107 changed. The setup record has the first-run results, the digests of the 8 completed cases, the second pass and updated Setup Agent Notes.
